Title: Aim Card VS Ammo Card: easy confirmation needed

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

Can you please confirm me that "Aim" and "Ammo" are two different keywords without any relations?
I mean:
Question 1: Can I use Target Vitals with Magazine ? (I hope not)
Question 2: Can I play Target Vitals and Manstopper Round on the same gun strike ? (I would say yes...)

Card Texts:
Name: Manstopper Rounds
Cardtype: Combat
Ammo.
No more than one ammo card can be used on a gun each combat.

Name: Target Vitals
Cardtype: Combat
Aim. (...) A minion can play only one aim each strike.

Name: Magazine
Cardtype: Combat
Put this card on a gun on this minion and put an ammo card from your hand on this card.
When using this gun, you may use the effect of the ammo card as if it were played from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal).

Thanks in advance,
Rémi.
